_doc: Arenas pintadas con Qwen (2026-11-03, pedido del usuario: 'MUY EPICAS'). tools/paint_arenas.py arma el plano y la pintura; tools/build_arenas.gd las escenas. size = celdas de la grilla en la que se marca todo; scale = agranda la arena (size x scale, misma pintura); water = piletas de agua de verdad [x, y, ancho, alto]; auto = umbral de brillo (celdas claras unidas al centro = piso) o null; open/solid = rectangulos [x, y, ancho, alto] que se abren o cierran despues; rocks = rocas que se rompen; cells = donde se para cada uno; field = la cancha; floor/wall = metatiles (colision y tags). brillo = aclara la pintura (las muy oscuras).

arena_campo.prompt: Pixel art, top-down 3/4 view of an epic outdoor trainer battle clearing in a forest for a 2D RPG, seen from above like a game map, 4:3, completely empty: nobody in it. A large flat open grass field in the middle with a worn dirt battle area, faint battle lines and a circle mark at the center, surrounded by lush layered pine and oak trees, big roots, mossy rocks, flowers and bushes, a small stream in one corner with a wooden bridge, sunbeams through the leaves. Rich detailed shading, crisp pixels, no blur. Empty scene with no people, no characters, no creatures, no figures, no text.

arena_gimnasio_agua.prompt: This image is the floor plan sketch of a water-type gym battle arena (dark = walls, light = floor, blue = water pools). Redraw it as an EPIC breathtaking water-type gym arena keeping EXACTLY the same layout: the blue pools stay as real water pools in the same place and size, the walls stay on the edges and the light floor stays open. A grand aquatic palace: white marble and aquamarine tiles, glowing blue water in the pools with ripples and light caustics, fountains and waterfalls on the back wall, a huge cascade badge emblem in the center of the floor, coral and shells, blue banners. At the top center a raised platform for the leader, at the bottom center the entrance. The battle field in the middle is large, flat and open, with no objects on it. Rich detailed shading, dramatic lighting, crisp pixels, no blur. Empty scene with no people, no characters, no creatures, no figures, no text, no letters.
